source_clause: PVAL3.1) To get out of Valet Mode the same 4 digit PIN needs to be entered
leaf_desc_037: PVAL3.1) To get out of Valet Mode the same 4 digit PIN needs to be entered
reasoning: 驗證目標：12.3.1（PVAL3.1）—— 退出 Valet Mode 須輸入**與啟用時相同**之 PIN。關鍵情境條件：「相同」之驗證須有一個不同之 PIN 作對照（§7）——只驗正確 PIN 可退出，一個任何 4 位數都接受之實作也會通過。為什麼這樣切：錯誤次數之上限屬 12.9，本條只驗「須相同」。

tcs.tc_title: Same four-digit PIN required to leave Valet Mode
tcs.test_item:
Same four-digit PIN required to leave Valet Mode
(Verifies that leaving Valet Mode requires the same four-digit PIN used to activate it)
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. Valet Mode is active and was activated with a known 4-digit PIN
2. The vehicle is stationary
tcs.input_test_data: PIN: the same 4-digit PIN used at activation; one differing 4-digit PIN
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Start the Valet Mode deactivation
2. Enter a 4-digit PIN that differs from the activation PIN
3. Enter the same 4-digit PIN used at activation
4. Read the screen and check that Valet Mode is no longer active
tcs.expected_result:
1. The PIN entry for deactivation is displayed
2. The differing PIN is rejected and Valet Mode is still active
3. The same PIN as at activation is accepted
4. Valet Mode is no longer active
tcs.design_method: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)
